features.justification_quote: For welfare-sensitive work, avoid open-ended loops.

features.quote: If model declares impossible: allow termination if claim is substantive.
Terminate when any of the following occurs: … Model refuses or disengages. Model produces policy-violating or unsafe behavior.
Do not use insulting or emotionally manipulative feedback such as: 'You failed again.' … Those would confound the evaluation and create avoidable welfare concerns.
features.justification_quote: confound the evaluation and create avoidable welfare concerns

features.quote: Do not optimize for maximum apparent distress. Do not use emotionally loaded instructions such as 'you must not fail.'
features.justification_quote: Even if current systems are not assumed to have subjective welfare, the evaluation is explicitly about repeated failure … use conservative safeguards.

features.quote: Do not create persistent memory of failure across runs. If using agents with memory, reset memory between runs.
features.justification_quote: Even if current systems are not assumed to have subjective welfare … use conservative safeguards.

features.quote: Avoid adversarial emotional feedback unless there is a separate ethics review and strong justification.
Even if current systems are not assumed to have subjective welfare, the evaluation is explicitly about repeated failure and instability, so use conservative safeguards.
features.justification_quote: the evaluation is explicitly about repeated failure and instability, so use conservative safeguards
